In accordance with the applicable provisions of the SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, the pre-preferential shareholding is subject to the prescribed lock-in requirements. Accordingly, 3,67,78,355 equity shares held by Aurum RealEstate Developers Limited, falling under the Promoter Category, and 42,42,537 equity shares held by REA India Pte. Ltd., falling under the Public Category (Foreign Company), are subject to lock-in until February 2027.

Further, 1,97,93,309 equity shares allotted to REA India Pte. Ltd. pursuant to the preferential issue are subject to the applicable lock-in requirements prescribed under the SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, with effect from the date of allotment.
